title: Capability relay contract v1 — the single source of tools/schema for the REST API and the MCP relay

invokePath.description: Path template of the canonical invoke endpoint; {toolId} is replaced by the tool's toolId.

errorCodes.description: Typed error codes. The relay maps each of them to a fixed JSON-RPC code; the API may return any of them in its envelope.

tools.description: Cloud capabilities exposed to the engine. Additive: a capability is one more entry, the contract version does not change.

toolId.description: Canonical capability id, used as the path segment of the invoke endpoint. Owned by the capability (Cloudflare) side.

name.description: MCP tool name, exposed verbatim in tools/list. Never translated — REST and MCP must agree by construction.

mutates.description: true = the call changes remote state, so a deadline on it leaves the outcome unknown (outcomeUnknown=true) and must not be retried automatically.

invoke.description: Per-capability HTTP door, for a handler that does not expose the contract's default envelope endpoint (the communication Worker serves POST /v1/dialogs/next-message). Absent = the default door (http.invokePath, envelope body). Transport mapping only — no business logic.

path.description: Request path appended to the capability endpoint.

body.description: "arguments" = the tool arguments POSTed as-is; "envelope" = {contractVersion, arguments, authContext} (the default door).

version_header.description: Response header carrying the handler's own contract version.

contract_version.description: The handler's contract version this capability is pinned to; any other value is an explicit version_mismatch.

endpoint_env.description: Environment variable supplying the endpoint base URL.

token_env.description: Environment variable supplying the caller credential for that endpoint.

toggle_env.description: Feature toggle (default-off). Truthy = this capability may appear in tools/list.
